result: Design for the libc utilities (plan/utilities.md): probed compatibility surface and callers, five architectures weighed, recommended a library per domain holding both sides of each format with one executable per domain and a freestanding static ldconfig; proof plan, 18 stories, 8 owner questions
head: 8dd0e5cd0

gate.affected: 2 suites, 390 passed / 0 failed (design only, no code)

rulings.item: Q1 architecture: library per domain with both sides of each format, one executable per domain (argv[0]), ldconfig freestanding static
rulings.recommendation: approve (d); UTIL-SHAPE may move a domain to separate programs
Rust tz API in liella-native after UTIL-10; locale API deferred; no new C ABI

rulings.item: Q3 identity strings (--version banners, help bug line, Cache generated by)
rulings.recommendation: Liella's own identity after the mirror scan counts banner parsers

rulings.item: Q4 not shipped: iconvconfig, /etc/bindresvport.blacklist, libc-devtools (sprof, sotruss, mtrace)
rulings.recommendation: drop with differences rows unless the mirror scan finds users
refuse with a message, consistent with #941; differences row, no restore flag

rulings.item: Q6 ldd on a program for another loader
rulings.recommendation: list by Liella's rules with a note on stderr; never run another interpreter

rulings.item: Q7 spec home for the utilities
rulings.recommendation: new spec section with its own decision series and view

rulings.item: Q8 locales package commands (locale-gen, update-locale, validlocale)

informational: dpkg refuses to unpack or configure without ldconfig and start-stop-daemon in PATH (exit 2), so ldconfig must exist in the first Aqours root
No per-story briefs written under handoff/LIELLA-UTILITIES-DESIGN/: the owner reviews first; plan section 6 has what the briefs need
Devuan excalibur's libc-bin contents not probed (no download permission for this story); caller counts come from one build server
records/pending/LIELLA-UTILITIES-DESIGN-1.toml (D-NEW, series D-X) needs an id from the coordinator

impact.what: design and plan only; no behaviour changes
UTIL-0 to UTIL-16 and UTIL-SHAPE (after the owner's review)
